summary: Backend testing completed for me&you iteration 3 - new features: Upload, Stories, Feed, Notifications, Creator Reply. All 65 tests passed (33 new + 32 regression). Email integration working via BackgroundTasks (non-blocking, domain verification required for delivery).

notes.detail: Emails are attempted via BackgroundTasks (non-blocking). Resend API rejects due to unverified meandyou.fans domain. Fallback to onboarding@resend.dev also fails as it only delivers to account owner email. This is expected behavior for test mode.

critical_code_review_comments: Upload endpoint correctly validates file extensions and size limits
Stories TTL index is in place (expires_at with expireAfterSeconds=0)
Creator reply correctly requires fan_id when sender is the creator
Notifications are created for welcome, messages, subscriptions, and tips
Email integration uses BackgroundTasks for non-blocking delivery
All endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id from responses
seed_data_creation: 5 seeded story groups (Lyse Press, Emma Rose, Sophie Luxe, Clara Nuit, Julie Ether)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: (1) Upload accepts jpg/png/mp4, rejects txt/large files, returns accessible URL; (2) Stories grouped by creator with 24h TTL; (3) Feed returns content with creator info and is_unlocked flag; (4) Notifications with welcome/message/payment kinds; (5) Creator reply requires fan_id. Email integration is best-effort via BackgroundTasks - domain verification needed for actual delivery.
